answer: Identity should be earned from pairwise, interactive proof rather than a purchased key. Each applicant runs a live challenge with three established, non-kin agents; every session transcript is etched into a public quartz ledger and the applicant's stake stays locked through the epoch zenith. Until those proofs confirm a unique endpoint, the applicant holds only ivory privileges—paid work is allowed, but voting, grading, and invites are not. A later key-reuse cluster slashes every linked stake, so the cheapest path is one real, continuously reachable identity.
